Yes, that changes the positioning in an important way. I’d send Jacques this updated version:

Hey Jacques, I was reviewing the landing page, and I think we need to shift the messaging before we send more traffic to it.

Right now, the page makes us look like a **lead follow-up automation company**. The main message is basically, “We follow up, book and confirm your leads automatically.” That is only one piece of what makes us different, and it makes the offer feel much smaller than it actually is.

We absolutely **do help med spas get more leads**. The difference is that we are not a generic marketing agency running the same ads, offers and strategies across 20 different industries.

**We are aesthetics-only.** I’ve spent nearly two decades in marketing and inside the aesthetics and medical space, so we understand the actual patient journey, what makes someone book, where leads get lost, what happens at the front desk, why consults do or don’t convert, and what gets patients to come back.

That needs to be the differentiator.

The messaging should be more along the lines of:

**MORE LEADS ARE GREAT. BETTER LEADS AND A BETTER SYSTEM TO CONVERT THEM ARE EVEN BETTER.**

Or:

**YOUR MED SPA DOESN’T NEED ANOTHER GENERIC MARKETING AGENCY. IT NEEDS AN AESTHETICS GROWTH PARTNER.**

Most agencies focus on generating a lead and consider their job done. **We don’t.**

We help bring in better-fit opportunities using marketing built specifically for the aesthetics industry, and then we look at the entire journey from **lead generation → follow-up → booking → show-up → conversion → retention**.

That is the end-to-end difference.

The landing page also needs to match the ads much more closely. If the ad talks about the revolving door of marketing agencies, wasted leads, poor follow-up, or the frustration of paying for leads that never turn into patients, the landing page needs to continue that exact conversation.

I also think we need to bring **our experience and specialization** much higher up on the page. We are not another agency that decided med spas were a profitable niche. We understand this industry from the inside, and our marketing strategy is built around how aesthetic practices actually operate and grow.

I’d also change **“We do the work for you”** to something more specific:

**“We don’t just send you leads and disappear. We help build, implement and improve the entire system that turns marketing into booked, paying and returning patients.”**

And the scheduler is taking up too much of the mobile page too early. I’d put a strong CTA above it, establish why we are different first, and then move the full calendar lower.

Overall, the page needs to communicate one thing immediately:

**We help med spas get better leads AND build a better system for turning those leads into long-term revenue.**

**Aesthetics only. End to end. Built by people who actually understand this industry.**

That is the story I want the page and ads telling consistently.

Here is the **exact replacement copy** I would send Jacques:

---

**Please replace the current top section with this:**

### FOR MED SPA & AESTHETIC PRACTICES

# YOUR MED SPA DOESN’T NEED ANOTHER GENERIC MARKETING AGENCY.

## You need an aesthetics growth partner who understands how to turn better leads into booked, paying, returning patients.

Most marketing agencies focus on getting you leads and stop there.

**We don’t.**

The Luxora Collective is built exclusively for med spas and aesthetic practices. With nearly two decades of experience in marketing and the medical aesthetics industry, we understand what happens before **and** after a lead comes in.

We help you attract better-fit leads, follow up faster, book more consultations, improve show rates, strengthen conversion, and create systems that keep patients coming back.

### **Because more leads only matter when you have the right system to turn them into revenue.**

✓ Marketing built specifically for med spas and aesthetics  
✓ Better-fit leads, not generic traffic  
✓ Follow-up and booking systems that keep opportunities from slipping through the cracks  
✓ An end-to-end growth strategy from acquisition through retention  

### **BOOK YOUR FREE 20-MINUTE GROWTH CALL**

**No generic marketing audit. No pitch deck. Just a real conversation about where your growth is getting stuck and what we see as the biggest opportunities to fix it.**

**[BOOK MY FREE CALL]**

---

**Then below the scheduler, I would lead into the next section with:**

# MOST MARKETING AGENCIES STOP WHEN THE LEAD COMES IN.

## THAT’S WHERE WE’RE JUST GETTING STARTED.

Getting attention is only the beginning.

A lead still has to be followed up with, booked, confirmed, shown up, converted into a paying patient, and given a reason to come back.

That is why The Luxora Collective takes an **end-to-end approach to growth.**

**Better marketing. Better leads. Better follow-up. Better conversion. Better retention.**

All built specifically for the aesthetics industry.

---

I would also tell Jacques that **“AESTHETICS ONLY. END TO END.”** could become a very strong recurring phrase across the landing page and ads. It is short, memorable, and immediately explains two of your biggest differentiators.

Based on what you’ve been told recently about **simplifying the offer, making the pain specific, and leading with the business outcome**, I would **not run this page as-is**. It is polished, but the messaging is pulling you backward into **“we are a lead follow-up automation company”** instead of positioning TLC as the **end-to-end growth partner** you have been trying to become.

The biggest problem is this:

> **“What if every lead got followed up, booked, and confirmed, without your team chasing anyone?”**

That sells **a feature**. It does not sell **the larger problem you solve**.

A med spa owner can look at this and think:

- “Oh, they do automated follow-up.”
- “I already have GoHighLevel.”
- “My CRM does that.”
- “My marketing agency says they do that.”
- “I can hire someone to set this up.”

And this line makes that positioning even narrower:

> **“We built the system that follows up, books, and confirms every single lead automatically, so your calendar fills itself.”**

That is a **big promise**, and it is also not really what makes TLC different. You do not just build automation. You look at the **entire path from marketing → lead → follow-up → booking → show-up → consultation → conversion → retention**.

## The page is also too disconnected from the ad

If your ads are saying things like:

**“You don’t need another average marketing agency. You need an aesthetic growth partner.”**

Or:

**“You need an end-to-end marketing system, not more cheap leads that never get followed up.”**

Or talking about the **revolving door / marketing hamster wheel**, then the landing page needs to continue that exact thought.

Right now, someone clicks an ad about a **bigger systemic problem** and lands on a page that basically says:

**“We automate lead follow-up.”**

That shrinks the perceived value of the offer.

## What I would change

The page should lead with the **real pain**:

**Med spas do not necessarily need more leads. They need to stop losing the opportunities they already paid for.**

Then explain that the leak can happen **anywhere in the growth process**, not just follow-up.

I would rewrite the top section like this:

---

# **YOU DON’T NEED MORE LEADS.**
## **YOU NEED TO STOP LOSING THE ONES YOU ALREADY PAID FOR.**

Most med spas don’t have one marketing problem. They have leaks across the entire process.

Leads come in and get followed up too slowly. Calls get missed. Consults don’t show. Front desks get busy. Old patients disappear. And owners keep spending more on marketing without knowing where the revenue is actually being lost.

**That’s the problem we fix.**

The Luxora Collective is an end-to-end growth partner built specifically for med spas and aesthetic practices. We look at the entire path from **marketing to lead follow-up to booking to conversion to retention** and find where your growth is breaking down.

**Before you spend another dollar trying to get more leads, let’s find out what’s happening to the opportunities you already have.**

✓ Find where leads and revenue are slipping through the cracks  
✓ See what may be costing you booked appointments and returning patients  
✓ Identify the biggest opportunities to improve your current growth system  
✓ Walk away knowing where to focus next  

### **FREE 20-MINUTE GROWTH CALL**
**No pitch deck. No generic marketing audit. Just a look at what’s actually happening inside your business.**

**[BOOK MY FREE CALL]**

---

### One thing I would be careful with

I would **not** say:

> “We do the work for you.”

Not this early and not without context. It is vague, and it can create confusion because you do not literally operate every part of their med spa.

Instead:

> **We don’t hand you another course and tell you to figure it out. We help build, implement, and improve the systems behind your growth.**

That connects directly to the **course fatigue / DIY fatigue** messaging you have been working on.

## An even punchier version

If you want the page to feel more aggressive and match your current ad direction:

# **MORE LEADS WON’T FIX A BROKEN GROWTH SYSTEM.**

**If your leads aren’t being followed up with, your consults aren’t converting, or your patients aren’t coming back, spending more on ads just puts more money into a leaking bucket.**

That’s why The Luxora Collective looks at the **entire patient growth journey**, not just your ads.

**Marketing. Follow-up. Booking. Conversion. Retention.**

We find where revenue is getting lost, fix the gaps, and help you build a system designed to turn more opportunities into paying, returning patients.

**Because you don’t need another average marketing agency sending you leads and disappearing. You need an aesthetic growth partner who understands what happens after the lead comes in.**

### **Book a free 20-minute call.**
**No pitch deck. No generic audit. Just a real look at where your growth may be getting stuck.**

---

## My biggest strategic change

I would **not make “automated follow-up” the hero of this page**.

Make the hero:

> **The problem isn’t always getting more leads. It’s what happens after you get them.**

Then automated follow-up becomes **proof of how you solve one part of the problem**, rather than becoming your entire identity.

The page should communicate this hierarchy:

**BIG PROBLEM:** Med spas are wasting opportunities and revenue across a disconnected growth process.

**YOUR DIFFERENCE:** Most agencies stop at generating the lead. TLC looks at what happens from acquisition through retention.

**YOUR MECHANISM:** You help identify and fix the gaps in marketing, follow-up, booking, conversion, and retention.

**THE CTA:** A low-pressure call to identify where their biggest growth opportunities are.

Also, visually, the **calendar widget is currently taking up an enormous amount of the first screen**. On mobile, I would shorten the copy, put a clear CTA button above the scheduler, and move the actual embedded calendar slightly lower. The visitor should understand **why they should book** before being confronted with a giant scheduling interface.

The strongest hero line for where TLC is headed, in my view, is:

# **YOU DON’T NEED MORE LEADS.**
## **YOU NEED A BETTER SYSTEM FOR TURNING THEM INTO REVENUE.**

**Most agencies stop when the lead comes in. We don’t.**

That last sentence is probably the clearest, simplest articulation of what makes TLC different.

Hey Jacques, I was reviewing the landing page, and I think we need to shift the messaging before we send more traffic to it.

Right now, the page makes us look like a **lead follow-up automation company**. The main message is basically, “We follow up, book and confirm your leads automatically.” That is only one small piece of what makes us different, and it makes our offer feel much smaller and easier to compare to a CRM, GHL automation, or another marketing agency.

The messaging needs to match the direction we’ve been discussing with the ads. **We are an end-to-end growth partner for med spas. Most agencies stop when the lead comes in. We don’t.**

I think the core message should be something closer to:

**YOU DON’T NEED MORE LEADS.  
YOU NEED A BETTER SYSTEM FOR TURNING THEM INTO REVENUE.**

**Most agencies stop when the lead comes in. We don’t.**

Then explain that most med spas have leaks across the entire process: marketing, slow follow-up, missed calls, booking, no-shows, consultation conversion and retention. Throwing more money at ads does not fix a broken or disconnected system.

Our difference is that we look at the **entire journey from marketing → lead → follow-up → booking → show-up → conversion → retention** and help identify and fix where revenue and opportunities are being lost.

The landing page also needs to match the ads much more closely. If the ad talks about the revolving door, wasted leads, poor follow-up, or needing an end-to-end system instead of another average marketing agency, the landing page needs to continue that exact conversation. Right now, the ad can introduce a big problem, but the landing page reduces the solution to automated follow-up.

I’d also change **“We do the work for you”** to something more specific like:

**“We don’t hand you another course and tell you to figure it out. We help build, implement and improve the systems behind your growth.”**

And I think the scheduler is taking up way too much of the mobile page too early. I’d put a strong CTA button above it, let them understand the value first, and then move the full calendar lower.

Overall, I want the page to make it immediately clear that **we are not selling leads, automation, or another marketing service in isolation. We fix the disconnect between getting opportunities and actually turning those opportunities into paying, returning patients.** That is the difference we need to hammer home.
